trimmedBy: node trim-ats-a-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by job id, regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: PERMISSION IS UNCLEAR, NOT DOCUMENTED-PUBLIC: the endpoint is documented without credentials, but https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 401, so this host states no robots verdict and the permission field must not read stronger than that. 59 jobs captured (0.82 MB), 4 kept: workplaceType null with isRemote null, a job with a published compensation tier ("$200K – $270K • Offers Equity"), a job with two secondary locations, and a Remote one. OWNERSHIP: descriptionPlain names Supabase in 59 of 59 jobs ("ABOUT SUPABASE: Supabase is the Postgres development platform ..."). Documented (https://developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/public-job-posting-api): a public endpoint with no credentials in the example; the page states no rate limit or terms of use. robots.txt: https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 401, so NO robots verdict exists for the API host (recorded as such, not as permission). The payload carries NO employer name; employer evidence is the posting text naming the employer. includeCompensation=true was requested; every job carries a compensation object, empty tiers where the employer published none. isListed was true on every one of 1,612 postings across 10 non-empty boards, so no unlisted posting was ever captured. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
